 BOISE, Idaho (CBS2) — Unseasonably warm weather is expected to build across the West this weekend and into next week as a ridge of high pressure develops over the region, pushing temperatures toward daily record highs in many locations.
 On Saturday, conditions are expected to be partly sunny through midmorning before turning sunny, with a high near 65. Southeast winds are forecast at 9 to 18 mph.
 Saturday night is expected to be partly cloudy with a low around 40. Breezy conditions are forecast, with southeast winds of 17 to 20 mph and gusts as high as 34 mph.
